pages.text: Some patches of ground hold their colour poorly. The scraps found there are cold, light, and slow to crumble. There is no movement in them.
pages.title: A field copy
Pale traces
pages.text: Look for pale traces on natural ground and harvest them for dormant flakes. Cold tissue is safe to handle. If nearby ground has been searched, try newly explored country.

pages.title: A place to begin
pages.text: A book and one flake make a field journal. A replacement copy will keep the discoveries you have already made.

pages.title: A place to begin

pages.title: The first charter
pages.text: The Overworld is sheltered by what these notes call the Stillness. Ordinary collection does not weaken it; keeping your home quiet requires no maintenance.

pages.title: The first charter
pages.text: Refine essence, build a terminal, and begin with Field Survey. Follow the offered training charters. Their instructions are worth learning before taking equipment farther afield.
Your discoveries belong to you. A replacement book remembers them.
